item.title: Tarik Skubal wins salary arbitration case, will be paid record $32 million
item.description: Tarik Skubal won his salary arbitration hearing with the Detroit Tigers on Thursday, and the two-time Cy Young Award winner will be paid a record $32 million this year instead of the team’s $19 million offer.

item.title: Argentina and US sign a major trade deal to slash tariffs and boost a political alliance
item.description: It reflects the close alliance between the radical libertarian and President Donald Trump.

item.title: Steve Bannon: ICE should ‘surround’ polling places in midterm elections
item.description: The populist ally of President Trump claimed that ICE agents, who have spearheaded the nationwide mass deportation campaign, could be deployed to prevent supposed election fraud, even though their mission is supposed to be limited to immigration enforcement.

item.title: Republicans reject complaint about Gabbard as Democrats question time it took to see it
item.description: The top Democrat on the House Intelligence Committee said he will keep looking into it.

item.title: Census Bureau plans to use survey with a citizenship question in its test for 2030, alarming experts
item.description: The ACS includes a citizenship question while the census form does not.

item.title: Burnett scores career-high 31, No. 2 Michigan routs Penn St 110-69 to reach school-record 21-1 mark
item.description: Nimari Burnett scored a career-high 31 points, leading No. 2 Michigan to a 110-69 win over Penn State on Thursday night.

item.title: Riley, Cooper lead undermanned Wizards past Pistons, 126-117
item.description: Will Riley scored 20 points, Sharife Cooper added 18 and the Washington Wizards upset the Eastern Conference-leading Detroit Pistons 126-117 on Thursday night.

item.title: Pistons needed to make ‘a business decision’ with Jaden Ivey trade, coach says
item.description: Jaden Ivey’s time with the Detroit Pistons came to an end before he finished out his rookie contract with the team that drafted him fifth overall in 2022.

item.title: Cousino wins 12th straight, clinches MAC Blue title share with victory over Fraser; Ford tops GP North
item.description: Warren Cousino’s 12th straight victory came Thursday night at home, and the Patriots’ 68-56 victory over visiting Fraser secured at least a tie for the Macomb Area Conference Blue Division championship.

item.title: Fitzgerald blitzes L’Anse Creuse North to clinch MAC White title
item.description: Welcome back Mr. Marcellus Phelps. And welcome back, Mr. Macomb Area Conference White Division championship.
